name: WILLCOX, Andrew

headline.note: First-person evidence adds deferred study, an adjacent-farm ownership transition and deputy-mayor service. Council minutes establish mayoral campaign leave from2pm11April2022, but not farming or investment-work cessation. Aggregate22-year farming claim lacks precise boundaries, leave and personal full-time evidence. Investment disclosures do not establish employment; totals remain null. Koorelah Farms managing-director years1996–2010now identified; workload remains unknown.

career_spells.evidence_note: Willcox and party profiles describe him as a third-generation tomato farmer who worked in the family farm, later purchased and managed it, expanded domestic and export supply, and operated it with his wife, sister and brother-in-law. A detailed 2017 profile says Willcox and his wife sold their interest to the other family operators in 2010. The commencement, employing entities, ownership transitions, hours and leave are not fully published; the statement that he purchased the business at age 27 is not converted into an invented calendar date. First speech describes practical farm duties, an adjacent farm purchase preceding the family partnership, and 22 years of farming. This aggregate duration does not establish exact start, continuous full-time status or leave. Fifteen permanent staff refers to employees, not his personal hours. Newly identified Koorelah1996–2010managing-director stage is represented separately without replacing earlier undated farm work; all describe overlapping enterprise activity.
career_spells.counting_note: Substantive private farming activity is supported, but the unresolved boundaries, entities and workload prevent a documented full-time duration.

career_spells.employer: Private investments and small businesses, entities not identified
career_spells.evidence_note: Current political profiles call Willcox a small-business owner, while the 2017 career profile refers to off-farm investments that he and his wife managed alongside the farm. The entities, activities, dates, remuneration and workload are not identified, including whether these continued during elected office. The 2012 election is not evidence of investment activity ending; endpoint removed. A register transcription identifies trustee/investment companies and property-management trust interests, but beneficial ownership and dividends do not establish remunerated work. Employment status changed to unknown pending evidence of active work.
career_spells.counting_note: The evidence is too general to define or count an employment spell.

career_spells.evidence_note: Whitsunday Regional Council's 2021-22 annual report says Willcox was first elected in 2012 as Division 6 councillor and was sworn in as mayor on 4 April 2016. The exact 2012 commencement day is not stated in the sources reviewed. Deputy-mayor duties March 2013–March 2016 are recorded separately within this council service; no additive duration. Fresh APH indexed text gives councillor service March2012–March2013, followed by deputy mayor; ECQ election report records polling28April2012 and Willcox as successful Division6 candidate. March commencement therefore remains a source discrepancy, not an adopted refined start. Existing year-level start retained pending post-election declaration/minutes.

Council records give swearing-in on4April2016, unopposed re-election inApril2020 and resignation on15June2022 after the federal poll was declared. Official minutes acknowledge mayoral leave beginning at2pm on11April2022 and grant absence for the13April,27April and11May council meetings. They do not state whether mayoral remuneration continued or whether leave extended unchanged through election day.

Contemporary reporting records LNP endorsement on29August2021. Council minutes acknowledge mayoral leave from2pm11April2022 for three scheduled meetings during the federal campaign. No separate paid party employment is established, and the leave record does not establish campaign employment or remuneration.
career_spells.counting_note: Candidate and party activity is excluded.

career_spells.counting_note: Excluded category; not added to public/private employment headlines.

career_spells.evidence_note: Public professional index dates deputy role to March 2013–March 2016; first speech corroborates three years. Nested within councillor service, exact days unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Excluded category; not added to public/private employment headlines.

career_spells.employer: Adjacent farm, Bowen; legal entity unknown
career_spells.evidence_note: First speech distinguishes purchase of the neighbouring farm from later family-business partnership. Boundaries and relationship to aggregate farming spell unresolved; do not add as independent full-time duration.
career_spells.counting_note: Dates, substantive full-time status and/or leave remain insufficiently evidenced; no headline years calculated.

career_spells.employer: Koorelah Farms; employing/trustee legal entity to confirm
career_spells.evidence_note: Official parliamentary biography names managing director1996–2010. First speech and2017profile support active farming/business ownership, not merely passive governance. This is a named stage within the family-enterprise umbrella, not additional simultaneous calendar years. ABR locates JohnWillcoxFamilyDiscretionaryTrust trading-name connection; employment/ownership arrangement and pre2000entity unconfirmed. BornFarms is a possible successor lead, not an adopted employer.
career_spells.counting_note: Self-employed farming stage within broader enterprise; full-time hours,leave and exact boundaries unknown. Do not sum with umbrella/adjacent-farm spells.

research_notes: Identify every Willcox farming entity, employment/ownership transition and exact commencement; obtain hours and leave or other evidence of substantive full-time farming before the 2010 sale.

Resolve the party biography's 22-year private-sector statement against the 2010 farm sale and 2012 council transition, and identify the off-farm investment and small-business entities and whether they continued during elected office.
Obtain the exact 2012 councillor commencement date and confirm any remuneration/workload details for completeness while retaining local elected office as excluded.
Obtain the exact April 2022 mayoral leave interval, the mayoral resignation notice date and evidence concerning any simultaneous local/federal office between election and 15 June 2022.
Verify paid status of any LNP candidate or party work; current evidence establishes candidacy but not employment.

Follow-up 2026-10-02: first speech and public professional index reviewed; added study, adjacent farm and deputy mayor. Removed unsupported 2012 investment-work cutoff. No full-time total inferred from staff headcount or 22-year recollection.

Investment leads from register transcription: A & R Land, AJRW Investments, A & R Property Development, AR Supa Management, A & R Willcox, JSTW Holdings, JSTW Properties, OAG Properties, OAG Investments, R & A Corporation, Rayand, Rayandwill, Rayandwill Holdings, Rayandwill Investments, Rayandwill Properties, Rayandwill Land and JSTW Land. Obtain original disclosures and appointment/work evidence before treating these trustee/passive-investment directorships as substantive jobs; Bowen Farmers Transport dividends alone prove no employment.
